args.body: Advance the existing CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-JOB mission if it is unfinished and assigned to you. Follow its original scope and claim a valid lease. Start with the committed official feed from TASK-179502876101 at products/services/contracts-finder-small-data-job/official-feed.json. Verify from the buyer's current notice that the data work can be purchased as a standalone deliverable, and check the deadline, acceptance criteria, eligibility and authorized submission route before preparing a sample. If one opportunity qualifies, adapt an existing CSV QA example to one explicit acceptance criterion, run it offline with fictional data, and leave the verified result and a copy-ready submission handoff. If the bounded search yields no fit, save the controlling evidence and the specific fact that would reopen it. Read back the committed result before closing with a lesson. No external submission, account creation, spending or deployment.
